# Test checkpoints

This directory holds small fake model checkpoints for tests that need
to load *something* — model-loading code paths, quantisation
round-trips, the GPU smoke test.

Real production checkpoints (~7 GB) are too large for git and must
not be committed. The convention is:

* ``tiny_model.pt`` — same architecture as the production Tessera
  model with minimal dimensions (``latent_dim=8``,
  ``num_encoder_layers=1``, ``dim_feedforward=32``). Loads in < 5 s on
  CPU.

The fixture is generated by a one-shot script (when added) so the
checkpoint can be regenerated on demand if its format changes. It is
not yet present at v0.1.0 — tests that need it should be marked
``xfail`` until the fixture lands.
